records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Truckload services revenues, excluding fuel surcharges, represented 63.5% and 64.7% of total revenues, excluding fuel surcharges, for the quarters ended March 31, 2024, and 2023, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: For both operations, substantially all of our revenue is generated by transporting freight for customers and is predominantly affected by the rates per mile received from our customers, equipment utilization, and our percentage of non-compensated miles.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The truckload services division operating ratio, which measures the ratio of operating expenses, net of fuel surcharges, to operating revenues, before fuel surcharges, increased from 99.3% for the first quarter of 2023 to 104.2% for the first quarter of 2024.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Operating supplies and expenses increased from 10.0% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the first quarter of 2023 to 12.4% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the first quarter of 2024.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Non-operating income increased from 0.6% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the first quarter of 2023 to 3.7% of revenues, before fuel surcharges, during the first quarter of 2024.
